description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans message serialization functionality, specifically testing message serialization, deserialization, and cache invalidation headers within the Orleans framework.

classes.name: MessageSerializerTests
classes.description: A set of unit tests verifying the message serialization and deserialization logic of Orleans messaging system, including handling of header sizes, body sizes, and cache invalidation headers.

classes.name: MessageSerializerBackwardsCompatibilityStub
classes.description: A stub class used within tests to verify backward compatibility of cache invalidation headers across serialization versions.

methods.name: MessageTest_TtlUpdatedOnAccess
methods.description: Tests that the message's TTL is updated correctly when accessed.

methods.name: MessageTest_TtlUpdatedOnSerialization
methods.description: Verifies that TTL remains consistent through serialization and deserialization.

methods.name: Message_SerializeHeaderTooBig
methods.description: Checks that serialization throws an exception when message header exceeds max size.

methods.name: Message_SerializeBodyTooBig
methods.description: Checks that serialization throws an exception when message body exceeds max size.

methods.name: Message_DeserializeHeaderTooBig
methods.description: Verifies that deserialization throws an exception when header size exceeds maximum.

methods.name: Message_DeserializeBodyTooBig
methods.description: Verifies that deserialization throws an exception when body size exceeds maximum.

methods.name: DeserializeFakeMessage
methods.description: Creates a fake message with specified header and body sizes for testing size limits.

methods.name: RoundTripMessage
methods.description: Serializes and deserializes a message, returning the deserialized message, used for testing message integrity.

methods.name: MessageTest_CacheInvalidationHeader_RoundTripCompatibility
methods.description: Tests the serialization and deserialization of cache invalidation headers for backward compatibility.

methods.name: ReadCacheInvalidationHeaders
methods.description: Reads cache invalidation headers from a serialized stream, used in backward compatibility testing.

methods.name: WriteCacheInvalidationHeaders
methods.description: Writes cache invalidation headers to a stream, used in testing serialization.
